item.title: Glaukon #1424 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Glaukon #1424 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Glaukon is the cruel now.
